# Kids Brain Games by MPS

Offline React Native (0.88) Android app. Package: com.mps.kidsbrain

## Run (Windows PowerShell)
npm install; npx react-native start
(new window) npx react-native run-android

## Games (Easy / Hard / Expert x 30 levels each)
Memory Match, Simon Says, Connect Dots, Shape Puzzle, Odd One Out, Patterns,
Maths Pop, Spell It, Spot It, Maze Runner, Count & Tap, Fruit Sudoku

## Sound & music (all original, generated by tools/make_sounds.py)
- Two looping tracks: cheerful menu music and calmer in-game music
- Effects: tap, flip, pop, correct, gentle "boing" for mistakes, win fanfare, star chimes, magic gift, maze swoosh
- Musical notes for Simon pads, spelling letters and Sudoku
- Music toggle on Home; Music / Sound effects switches in Grown-ups settings
- Music pauses automatically when the app goes to background or an ad plays

## Ads (TEST ads are ON)
- Banner: Home + Level select screens only (never during play)
- Interstitial: between levels, every 3 wins, 2 min cool-down
- Rewarded: "Skip level" and "+10 stars" in Sticker Book (behind a parent gate)
- Child-directed, G-rated, non-personalised; AD_ID permission removed

## Before release
1. src/ads/ads.ts: USE_TEST_ADS = false and put real ad unit IDs
2. app.json: real AdMob App ID in android_app_id
3. src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx: real PRIVACY_URL
4. Play Console: Target audience = children, join Families policy, AdMob "child-directed" setting
